legend: Little town Nsk consists of n junctions connected by m bidirectional roads. Each road connects two distinct junctions and no two roads connect the same pair of junctions. It is possible to get from any junction to any other junction by these roads. The distance between two junctions is equal to the minimum possible number of roads on a path between them.

In order to improve the transportation system, the city council asks mayor to build one new road. The problem is that the mayor has just bought a wonderful new car and he really enjoys a ride from his home, located near junction s to work located near junction t. Thus, he wants to build a new road in such a way that the distance between these two junctions won't decrease.

You are assigned a task to compute the number of pairs of junctions that are not connected by the road, such that if the new road between these two junctions is built the distance between s and t won't decrease.
input: The firt line of the input contains integers n, m, s and t (2 ≤ n ≤ 1000, 1 ≤ m ≤ 1000, 1 ≤ s, t ≤ n, s ≠ t) — the number of junctions and the number of roads in Nsk, as well as the indices of junctions where mayors home and work are located respectively. The i-th of the following m lines contains two integers ui and vi (1 ≤ ui, vi ≤ n, ui ≠ vi), meaning that this road connects junctions ui and vi directly. It is guaranteed that there is a path between any two junctions and no two roads connect the same pair of junctions.
output: Print one integer — the number of pairs of junctions not connected by a direct road, such that building a road between these two junctions won't decrease the distance between junctions s and t.

legend.ai: 小镇 Nsk 由 n 个路口组成，这些路口之间通过 m 条双向道路相连。每条道路连接两个不同的路口，且不存在两条道路连接同一对路口。通过这些道路，可以从任意路口到达任意其他路口。两个路口之间的距离等于连接它们的路径上道路数量的最小值。
为了改善交通系统，市议会要求市长修建一条新道路。问题在于，市长刚买了一辆很棒的新车，非常享受从位于路口 s 附近的家前往位于路口 t 附近的工作地点的驾车过程。因此，他希望以一种不会缩短这两个路口之间距离的方式修建新道路。
你的任务是计算不直接由道路相连的路口对数，使得在这两个路口之间修建新道路后，s 与 t 之间的距离不会缩短。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含整数 n、m、s 和 t（2 ≤ n ≤ 1000，1 ≤ m ≤ 1000，1 ≤ s, t ≤ n，s ≠ t），分别表示 Nsk 中路口和道路的数量，以及市长家和工作地点所在路口的编号。接下来的 m 行中，第 i 行包含两个整数 ui 和 vi（1 ≤ ui, vi ≤ n，ui ≠ vi），表示这条道路直接连接路口 ui 和 vi。保证任意两个路口之间都存在路径，且不存在两条道路连接同一对路口。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，即不由直接道路相连的路口对数，使得在这两个路口之间修建道路后，路口 s 与 t 之间的距离不会缩短。
